description:
Perform the end-of-day visitor management procedure in Jolly Lobby Track. The application is currently open with three visitors signed in: Margaret Chen, James Rodriguez, and Priya Nair. Your goal is to sign out ALL currently active visitors to clear the building for closing. 

1. Identify the currently signed-in visitors in the active visitor list.
2. Sign out each visitor individually (Margaret Chen, James Rodriguez, and Priya Nair).
3. Verify that the active visitor list is completely empty.
4. Take a screenshot of the empty active visitor list and save it to '/tmp/signout_complete.png'.
